project.name: KPR House Hunter
project.idea_raw:
I want a personal tool, KPR House Hunter, for my own house search in Indonesia.
I give it a local listings file (exported from property sites) and it filters
the listings into a shortlist that fits my KPR (mortgage) situation.
Keep my personal profile and financial inputs local; nothing about my income
or savings leaves my machine. The first workflow is: load my listings file,
apply my criteria and affordability limits, and get a ranked shortlist.

S0.q1.q: Tell me everything in your head about this idea — what it is, who it's for, why you want it. Multi-paragraph is welcome; don't organize it, just pour it out.
S0.q1.a:
I want a personal tool, KPR House Hunter, for my own house search in Indonesia.
I give it a local listings file (exported from property sites) and it filters
the listings into a shortlist that fits my KPR (mortgage) situation.
Keep my personal profile and financial inputs local; nothing about my income
or savings leaves my machine. The first workflow is: load my listings file,
apply my criteria and affordability limits, and get a ranked shortlist.

S0.q2.q: Language: You wrote in English, so I'll ask my questions in English. Is that right, or would you prefer Bahasa Indonesia? (The planning documents are written in English either way.)
S0.q2.a: Bahasa: sesuaikan dengan bahasa user, jadi tanya dalam bahasa Indonesia.

S0.q3.q: Name: I'll call it KPR House Hunter (short name: kpr-house-hunter). Keep it, or rename?

S0.q4.q: Country: I'll research the rules and costs for Indonesia. Is that where you'll use it? If you're looking in particular cities or provinces, name them. Housing rules and prices differ by region.
S0.q4.a: Negara: Indonesia. Kota/provinsi: lewati untuk sekarang (tidak dijawab).

S1.q1.q: Alat ini mau berbentuk apa? a. Aplikasi web lokal: dibuka di browser, tapi hanya jalan di laptop atau server Anda sendiri. b. Alat command-line. c. Skill atau plugin untuk agen AI. d. Kombinasi, atau belum yakin.
S1.q1.a: (a) Aplikasi web lokal, hanya jalan di laptop saya.

S1.q2.q: Dari mana file listing Anda nanti berasal, dan formatnya apa? Situs mana saja, dan kira-kira berapa listing per file?
S1.q2.a: Saya salin manual ke spreadsheet CSV dari Rumah123, 99.co, atau Lamudi, sekitar 20-50 listing per file.

S1.q3.q: Enam bulan setelah alat ini ada, apa yang berubah dalam proses cari rumah Anda sehingga Anda bilang alat ini berguna?
S1.q3.a: Tanda berhasil: menyaring listing jauh lebih cepat, dan saya tidak lagi tertarik pada rumah yang ternyata di luar kemampuan cicilan.

S1.q4.q: Yang saya anggap sudah diketahui dari ide Anda (koreksi kalau keliru): masalahnya menyaring banyak listing menjadi daftar pendek sesuai batas KPR dan kriteria; penggunanya hanya Anda; data penghasilan dan tabungan tidak keluar dari komputer Anda. Juga keputusan D-001 (istilah standar KPR).
S1.q4.a: Konfirmasi: masalah, pengguna (hanya saya), syarat data lokal, dan D-001 benar.

S1.q5.q: Country: I'll research the rules and costs for Indonesia. Is that where you'll use it? If you're looking in particular cities or provinces, name them. (bagian kota/provinsi dari S0.q4, dijawab menyusul)
S1.q5.a: Tambahan S0: kota/area = Jakarta Selatan, dan Depok bagian yang berbatasan dengan Jakarta Selatan.

S1.q6.q: Usulan halaman dan cara membuka aplikasi: bookmark ke alamat lokal di laptop (http://localhost:…), tanpa login karena hanya bisa diakses dari laptop Anda; tiga halaman: Impor CSV, Profil & Kriteria, Daftar Pendek. Setuju?

S1.q7.q: Setelah daftar pendek muncul, apa langkah berikutnya? Pilihannya: simpan daftar pendek sebagai CSV, cetak, beri tanda favorit, atau cukup dilihat di layar.
S1.q7.a: Simpan daftar pendek sebagai CSV, lengkap dengan perkiraan cicilan dan dana tunai awal per rumah.

S1.q8.q: Bahasa di layar aplikasi: Bahasa Indonesia, Inggris, atau campuran?
S1.q8.a: Bahasa Indonesia, dengan istilah KPR standar sesuai D-001.

S2.q1.q: Anda mempertimbangkan rumah baru dari developer, rumah seken, atau keduanya?
S2.q1.a: Keduanya. CSV punya kolom baru/seken, harga di listing dianggap harga final, versi pertama tidak menghitung PPN.

S2.q2.q: NPOPTKP untuk rumah di Depok: a. Pakai Rp80 juta (batas minimum nasional) sebagai perkiraan terburuk, atau b. biarkan kosong dan tandai belum lengkap?
S2.q2.a: a. Pakai Rp80 juta sebagai bawaan konservatif, bisa diubah.

S2.q3.q: Laptop Anda pakai sistem apa (Windows, Mac, atau Linux), apakah sudah ada layanan berbayar yang terkait, dan berapa anggaran bulanan untuk aplikasinya?
S2.q3.a: Linux, tidak ada layanan berbayar, anggaran Rp0/bulan.

S2.q4.q: (Konfirmasi keputusan) D-010 sampai D-014 — koreksi kalau ada yang tidak sesuai.

S2.q5.q: Seberapa sering Anda akan memasukkan file listing baru? Sebutkan untuk bulan biasa dan bulan sibuk.
S2.q5.a: Bulan biasa 2-4 file (±100-200 listing), bulan sibuk 2-3 file per minggu (±400-600 listing).

S2.q6.q: Bagaimana Anda mau menyalakan aplikasinya? a. Mengetik satu perintah di terminal setiap kali mau pakai. b. Aplikasi menyala otomatis saat laptop hidup.

S2.q7.q: Berapa waktu per minggu yang Anda mau sisihkan untuk merawat aplikasi?
S2.q7.a: Sekitar 15 menit per bulan; tampilkan tanggal terakhir tiap angka bawaan diperbarui dan peringatkan jika lebih dari 30 hari.

S3.q1.q: Data apa saja yang disimpan aplikasi di laptop? Apakah CSV Anda juga berisi nama atau nomor HP agen?
S3.q1.a: Simpan semua yang diusulkan; CSV kadang berisi nama/nomor HP agen, buang kolom itu saat impor dan simpan link listing saja.

S3.q2.q: Kalau laptop hilang atau rusak, apa yang harus aman dan bisa dipulihkan? a. Enkripsi disk Linux + tombol Ekspor cadangan; b. enkripsi di aplikasi dengan kata sandi; c. tanpa cadangan. Apakah enkripsi disk sudah aktif?
S3.q2.a: a. Enkripsi disk Linux plus tombol Ekspor cadangan. Status enkripsi disk saya: tidak tahu.

S3.q3.q: Cara menghapus data: a. Hapus semua data; b. hapus per file impor; c. keduanya.
S3.q3.a: c. Keduanya, konfirmasi dengan mengetik HAPUS, profil keuangan bisa dihapus terpisah.

S3.q4.q: (Konfirmasi keputusan) D-021 sampai D-023 — koreksi kalau ada yang tidak sesuai.

S3.q5.q: (Konfirmasi keputusan) D-027, D-028, D-029 — koreksi kalau ada yang tidak sesuai.

S3.q6.q: Kapan aplikasi mengingatkan Anda membuat cadangan? a. bersamaan dengan pengingat 30 hari angka bawaan; b. setiap selesai impor; c. tidak perlu.

S3.q7.q: File cadangan berisi penghasilan dan tabungan dalam bentuk terbaca. a. biarkan apa adanya dengan peringatan saat ekspor; b. kunci dengan kata sandi.
S3.q7.a: a. Biarkan apa adanya dengan peringatan saat ekspor.

S4.q1.q: F-01 Impor listing dan susun daftar pendek: apakah langkah 1-6 (bookmark → Impor CSV → pratinjau → Impor → Daftar Pendek dengan cicilan, dana tunai awal, catatan, rumah gugur beserta alasan → Simpan CSV) sudah benar?
S4.q1.a: Setuju dengan langkah F-01 seperti ditulis.

S4.q2.q: Aturan mampu bayar: a. 30% penghasilan bersih dikurangi cicilan lain, dihitung pada bunga floating (bawaan 11%); b. pada bunga promo; c. tentukan sendiri.
S4.q2.a: a. 30% (bisa diubah), dihitung pada bunga floating bawaan 11%, tampilkan cicilan masa promo dan setelah promo.

S4.q3.q: Urutan daftar pendek: a. paling banyak memenuhi nice-to-have lalu dana tunai awal terkecil; b. cicilan teringan; c. harga per m² termurah.
S4.q3.a: a. Paling banyak memenuhi nice-to-have, lalu dana tunai awal paling kecil.

S4.q4.q: (Konfirmasi keputusan) D-032 dan D-033 — koreksi kalau ada yang tidak sesuai.

S4.q6.q: Listing yang sama masuk dua kali: a. link sama = satu rumah, impor terbaru menggantikan; b. simpan keduanya; c. tanya satu per satu.
S4.q6.a: a. Link sama dianggap satu rumah, impor terbaru menggantikan.

S4.q7.q: F-02 Isi profil dan kriteria: apakah langkah 1-6 (Keuangan, KPR per bank, Kriteria wajib, Nice-to-have, Simpan) benar? Rekomendasi tambahan: gugur jika dana tunai awal melebihi dana tunai yang diisi.
S4.q7.a: F-02 disetujui dengan tambahan aturan gugur jika dana tunai awal melebihi dana tunai yang diisi.

S4.q9.q: F-03 Perbarui angka bawaan: langkah 1-4 (pita kuning → halaman Angka Bawaan dengan tanggal dan link sumber → ubah atau Tandai sudah dicek → Simpan) dan prioritas.

S4.q10.q: F-04 Cadangan, pulihkan, hapus data: langkah 1-4 dan prioritas.
S4.q10.a: F-04 disetujui: ekspor dan hapus must, pulihkan should, dengan cadangan otomatis sebelum memulihkan.

S5.q1.q: Apakah D-045, D-046, D-047 dan D-048 (Python) disetujui?

S5.q2.q: Alat mana yang selama ini Anda pakai atau jadi pembanding? a. Rumah123; b. simulator bank; c. spreadsheet; d. belum pernah.

S5.q3.a: Python 3.14.4. Kalau perlu 3.15, masukkan cara pasang ke panduan serah terima.

S5.q4.q: Kerangka web mana yang dipakai? a. Django 6.1; b. FastAPI.

S6.q1.q: Apakah hasil pemeriksaan bidang yang diatur hukum (keuangan, kesehatan, jasa hukum, anak: tidak berlaku) sudah benar?
S6.q1.a: Benar, hasil pemeriksaan bidang diatur hukum sudah benar.

S6.q2.q: Apakah D-052 (satu file SQLite di folder home) disetujui?

S6.q3.q: Berapa lama listing lama disimpan? a. sampai dihapus sendiri; b. hapus otomatis setelah 12 bulan; c. tanya setiap kali.

S7.q1.q: Apakah kelima fitur (F-01 sampai F-05) masuk versi pertama, atau F-05 ditunda?
S7.q1.a: Kelima fitur F-01 sampai F-05 masuk versi pertama.

S7.q2.q: Jalankan pemeriksaan kritis cakupan sebelum dikunci, atau lewati?

S7.q3.q: Tenor dan umur: (a) tenor dipotong otomatis sesuai usia (bawaan 65), atau (b) tenor manual dengan peringatan?
S7.q3.a: Setuju (a): tenor dipotong otomatis sesuai usia, usia diketik pengguna sendiri secara lokal di aplikasi.

S7.q4.q: Notaris dan asuransi: (b) tanpa angka bawaan, dana tunai awal tampil 'belum lengkap' sampai diisi, atau (a) cari angka perkiraan bersumber?
S7.q4.a: Setuju (b): tanpa angka bawaan, tampil 'belum lengkap'.

S7.q5.q: Boleh saya terapkan perbaikan teks untuk format CSV, langkah pemasangan venv, tanggal DP 0%, dan biaya administrasi BCA?
S7.q5.a: Ya, terapkan perbaikan format CSV, venv, tanggal DP 0%, dan biaya administrasi BCA.

S7.q6.q: Setuju dengan contoh batas buang per fitur dan ukuran sukses, atau mau diubah?
S7.q6.a: Setuju contoh batas buang dan ukuran sukses.

S7.q7.q: Ini versi pertama? Setelah Anda jawab ya, daftar ini dibekukan. (In-MVP F-01 sampai F-05, Parking Lot kosong, setelah perbaikan S7.q3–S7.q6.)
S7.q7.a: Ya, ini versi pertama, F-01 sampai F-05, kunci daftar.

S8.q1.q: Setuju dengan urutan M0 → M1 → M2 → M3 → M4 (D-063), atau ada yang mau diubah?

S8.q2.q: Setuju dengan target mutu: Firefox dan Chromium, bisa dipakai dengan keyboard, log tanpa data keuangan (D-064)?

S8.q3.q: Nama tampilan aplikasi tetap "KPR House Hunter", atau mau diganti sebelum bundel ditulis?

S1.note: No evidence found that Rumah123, 99.co or Lamudi offer a listings export; this stays an open point inside the U-03 question.

S8.note: No brief item targets S8; the facts the milestones use were re-fetched today in RQ-015 and RQ-016. Nothing new.

decisions.summary: The tool labels its inputs and results with the standard Indonesian KPR terms: KPR, DP (uang muka), tenor, cicilan, rasio cicilan (DTI), bunga fixed/floating.
decisions.rationale: These are the words Indonesian banks and listing sites already use, so the owner can match the tool to a bank offer line by line; per U-11 [cite: general · https://www.rumah123.com/kemampuan-kpr/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · live]

decisions.summary: Platform shape: a local web app opened in the browser that runs only on the owner's laptop; no public hosting.
decisions.rationale: Owner's choice (S1.q1); it keeps income and savings on the owner's machine as required in S0.q1.

decisions.summary: Input is a CSV file the owner fills by hand from Rumah123, 99.co or Lamudi, about 20–50 listings per file; the tool never scrapes or fetches listing sites.
decisions.rationale: Owner's answer (S1.q2); manual private copying stays within Rumah123's terms, which forbid scraping and building a property database (U-03 [cite: legal · https://www.rumah123.com/en/terms-of-use/ · upd 2020-03 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live]).

decisions.summary: Success picture: filtering a listings file is much faster than by hand, and no house outside the owner's installment capacity reaches the shortlist.
decisions.rationale: Owner's answer (S1.q3).

decisions.summary: Target user: the owner alone, searching for a house to buy with a KPR; no other users or accounts.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed by the owner (S1.q4), stated in S0.q1.

decisions.summary: Hard constraint: the owner's profile, income and savings never leave the laptop; no network calls carry them.
decisions.rationale: Stated in S0.q1 and confirmed in S1.q4.

decisions.summary: Pages and entry point: the owner opens a bookmarked localhost address on the laptop, with no login; three pages, all for the owner only: Import CSV, Profile & Criteria, Shortlist.
decisions.rationale: Proposed by the designer and accepted in S1.q6 by the owner's delegated test agent; login and network binding are confirmed in S3.

decisions.summary: End of the main task: the owner saves the shortlist as a CSV that includes the estimated monthly installment and the upfront cash needed per house.
decisions.rationale: Answer S1.q7 by the owner's delegated test agent.

decisions.summary: Screen language: Indonesian, using the standard KPR terms of D-001.
decisions.rationale: Answer S1.q8 by the owner's delegated test agent.

decisions.summary: Minimum down payment is a per-bank setting the owner enters locally. Default: 5%. A 0% DP is used only for a bank the owner marks as offering it.
decisions.rationale: Only banks meeting BI bad-loan criteria may lend 100% until 31 Dec 2027; under PADG 30/2025 other banks stay at 95% LTV for landed houses above 70 m², so 5% is the safe default. Per U-01 [cite: regulation · https://www.bi.go.id/id/publikasi/peraturan/Pages/PADG_302025.aspx · upd 2025-12-24 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The upfront-cash estimate per house = DP + BPHTB + bank fees + notary and insurance estimates. BPHTB = 5% × (price − NPOPTKP). NPOPTKP is an area setting: South Jakarta default Rp250 juta; Depok has no default, so Depok houses show "BPHTB belum lengkap" until the owner enters the figure. Bank fee defaults (provisi 1%, administration, appraisal) are editable.
decisions.rationale: BPHTB and bank fees are cash due at or before the akad, and the owner asked for upfront cash per house (D-008). Per U-04 [cite: regulation · https://ortax.org/ketentuan-bphtb-dan-cara-menghitung · pub 2023-04-28 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26], U-15 [cite: regulation · https://news.ddtc.co.id/berita/daerah/1823579/beli-atau-dapat-warisan-properti-di-jakarta-pahami-kewajiban-pajaknya · pub 2026-10-26 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26], U-05 [cite: price · https://www.bca.co.id/id/individu/produk/pinjaman/kpr/kpr-first · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live]. The Depok gap (U-16) is handled by leaving no default, not by assuming a value.

decisions.summary: The tool applies no first-home BPHTB relief automatically; the estimate is the conservative, full BPHTB.
decisions.rationale: Sources disagree on the current DKI relief scheme, and eligibility depends on the owner's KTP, which stays off this conversation. A conservative estimate cannot hide a cash shortfall. Per U-17 [cite: regulation · https://pajakku.com/artikel/beli-rumah-pertama-di-jakarta-bisa-hemat-bphtb-hingga-50 · upd 2026-07-15 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The tool does not check credit history. The shortlist page and CSV carry a fixed note that bank approval also depends on the owner's SLIK OJK record.
decisions.rationale: Banks check SLIK; larger paylater or online-loan arrears can block a KPR even when the numbers fit. Per U-10 [cite: regulation · https://www.fortuneidn.com/finance/slik-dilonggarkan-nasabah-nunggak-di-bawah-rp1-juta-masih-bisa-ambil-kpr-subsidi-00-ccw2k-15tp04 · pub 2026-04-14 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: No paid account, hosting or store fee is needed: the app runs on the owner's laptop (D-002).
decisions.rationale: S2 hard-rule check against the S1 platform shape: a local web app has no app-store or hosting account. Shown here for correction.

decisions.summary: Both new (developer) and resale houses are in scope. The CSV has a new/resale column; the listed price is treated as the final price; version 1 does not compute VAT (PPN).
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q1). Avoids depending on the unresolved PPN DTP price limit (U-07).

decisions.summary: Depok NPOPTKP default = Rp80 juta, the national legal minimum, editable by the owner; this replaces the "no default" Depok rule in D-011.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q2). Rp80 juta is the verified national minimum, so BPHTB is never underestimated; per U-04 [cite: regulation · https://ortax.org/ketentuan-bphtb-dan-cara-menghitung · pub 2023-04-28 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]. Depok's own figure stays unverified (U-16, RQ-009).

decisions.summary: Budget ceiling for the tool: Rp0 per month; no paid services. Target device: the owner's Linux laptop.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q3).

decisions.summary: Usage: typical month 2–4 files (about 100–200 listings); busy month 2–3 files per week (about 400–600 listings). Running cost stays Rp0 at both levels because nothing is metered.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q5). A local app has no per-use fee (D-014, D-017).

decisions.summary: The owner starts the app with one terminal command when needed; nothing runs in the background otherwise.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q6).

decisions.summary: Upkeep: about 15 minutes per month. Every default figure (rates, fees, NPOPTKP, minimum DP) shows its last-updated date, and the app warns when a figure is more than 30 days old.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S2.q7). Rates and rules change, e.g. the 100% LTV relief ends 31 Dec 2027 (U-01).

decisions.summary: The local server listens only on 127.0.0.1 and rejects (HTTP 400) any request whose Host header is not localhost or 127.0.0.1 with the app port; no other device on the Wi-Fi and no website can read the profile.
decisions.rationale: Binding to loopback alone does not stop DNS rebinding from a website open in the same browser. Per U-18 [cite: general · https://github.com/nccgroup/singularity/wiki/Preventing-DNS-Rebinding-Attacks · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26] [cite: general · https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/api_security_testing/checks/dns_rebinding_check/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The app makes no network calls of its own: no analytics, no error reporting, no fonts or scripts from the internet, no external maps or AI services; it works with the internet off. Listing links in the CSV open only when the owner clicks them.
decisions.rationale: Hard constraint D-006: income and savings never leave the laptop; anything loaded from the internet could carry data out. No money flows in the app (D-014) and there is no login (D-007).

decisions.summary: No privacy policy, consent screen or data-protection officer is planned: the tool processes the owner’s own data for personal, household use only. If it is ever shared with other people or used commercially, this decision is reopened.
decisions.rationale: UU PDP Art. 2(2) excludes processing by an individual for personal or household purposes. Per U-02 [cite: regulation · https://jdih.komdigi.go.id/produk_hukum/view/id/832/t/undangundang%2Bnomor%2B27%2Btahun%2B2022 · pub 2022-10-17 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live · amend-check 2026-11-26] [cite: regulation · https://www.hukumonline.com/berita/a/mk--uu-pdp-lindungi-pemrosesan-data-privat-bersifat-nonkomersil-lt6454b8bc84511/?page=all · pub 2023-05-05 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: Stored on the laptop: the financial profile (income, savings, other installments), house criteria, bank and tax default figures with their last-updated dates, imported listings and the shortlist. Agent name and phone columns are dropped at import; only the listing link is kept.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q1). Keeping third-party contacts adds data nobody uses; the link leads back to them.

decisions.summary: Protection at rest relies on Linux full-disk encryption (LUKS); the app adds no password of its own. An "Ekspor cadangan" button writes all app data to one file the owner stores where they choose; an import restores it. The owner does not know whether disk encryption is on, so the handover includes a one-line check (lsblk -f shows crypto_LUKS) and the app shows a reminder on the Profile page until the owner ticks "sudah dicek".
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q2). An app password that is forgotten loses the data; nothing is backed up unless something does it on purpose.

decisions.summary: Erasure: "Hapus semua data", delete per import file, and delete the financial profile alone; each needs the owner to type HAPUS. Deleted data is removed from the app's storage file, not hidden. Exported backup files are the owner's to delete.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q3).

decisions.summary: Imported CSV is untrusted text: every cell is shown as plain text (never as HTML); only http/https listing links become clickable; files over 5 MB or 2,000 rows are refused with a plain message; in the exported shortlist CSV, cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so a spreadsheet cannot run them as formulas.
decisions.rationale: Threat-modeling pass (tampering): listing text is copied from public sites and may carry markup, javascript: links or spreadsheet formulas. Limits sit well above the busy month of 400–600 listings (D-018).

decisions.summary: Every request that changes data (import, save profile, delete) must come from the app's own page: the server checks that the Origin header is the app's localhost address and rejects anything else. A website cannot trigger "Hapus semua data" or overwrite the profile.
decisions.rationale: Threat-modeling pass (tampering): a hidden form on any website can send a request to localhost with a valid Host header, so the Host check of D-021 alone does not stop it.

decisions.summary: Instead of a legal privacy policy (not needed per D-023), the app has a short "Data & privasi" page in plain Indonesian: what is stored, that it never leaves the laptop, where the storage file lives, how to back up, and how to delete.
decisions.rationale: Privacy-policy rule: the product keeps personal data. No store or consent screen applies, so an in-app explanation meets the purpose.

decisions.summary: Backup reminder: shown together with the 30-day stale-defaults warning (D-020) when the last backup export is more than 30 days old or never made.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q6). Fits the 15-minute monthly upkeep.

decisions.summary: Backup files are not encrypted by the app in v1. Every export shows a warning: the file contains income and savings; keep it on an encrypted disk or a personal USB drive, not in cloud storage or chat apps. Residual risk accepted by the owner.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q7). A forgotten backup password would make the backup useless.

decisions.summary: A listing whose price per m² of land is below 60% of the median of listings in the same area within the loaded files is marked "Harga jauh di bawah pasaran — cek keaslian". It is not removed and not ranked higher for being cheap.
decisions.rationale: Per U-14 [cite: general · https://www.rumah123.com/panduan-properti/ciri-ciri-penipuan-tanah-kavling/ · pub 2026-06-04 · acc 2026-11-26]: a price far below comparables is a scam sign, and a cheapest-first ranking would push such listings to the top.

decisions.summary: The CSV may carry an optional certificate column (SHM, SHGB, AJB, PPJB/inden, unknown). The shortlist shows a plain note for anything other than SHM: SHGB "perlu perpanjangan", AJB/PPJB "belum sertifikat — cek ke notaris", unknown "status sertifikat belum diisi". Ranking does not change.
decisions.rationale: Per U-09 [cite: general · https://www.detik.com/properti/tips-dan-panduan/d-8238944/mau-beli-rumah-yang-belum-dibangun-cek-8-hal-ini-dulu-biar-nggak-ketipu · pub 2025-12-02 · acc 2026-11-26]: a cheap listing may be cheap because of its title or build status.

decisions.summary: F-01 Import listings and build the shortlist — happy path: open the bookmark (Import CSV page); choose the CSV (required columns: title, link, price, land area, building area, bedrooms, area Jaksel/Depok, new/resale; optional certificate); preview shows rows read, rejected rows with reasons and dropped agent columns; click Impor; the Shortlist page applies criteria and KPR limits from Profile & Criteria and lists passing houses in order with monthly installment, upfront cash and notes; rejected houses are viewable with reasons; click Simpan CSV to get the shortlist file.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q1).

decisions.summary: Affordability rule: maximum installment = net monthly income × 30% (editable) − other installments. A house passes only if its installment at the floating rate fits. Floating rate is set per bank, default 11%. The shortlist shows two installments: during the promo period and after it.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q2). Per U-08 [cite: price · https://www.bca.co.id/id/individu/produk/pinjaman/kpr/kpr-first · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live], U-12 [cite: legal · https://www.rumah123.com/kemampuan-kpr/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live], U-19 [cite: price · https://www.bankmandiri.co.id/web/guest/kpr-bunga-spesial · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live].

decisions.summary: Shortlist order: most nice-to-have criteria met first; ties broken by the smallest upfront cash.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q3). Avoids cheapest-first ranking that lifts likely scams (U-14).

decisions.summary: F-01 unhappy-path defaults. Abandon: nothing is saved until Impor is clicked; closing the tab during preview discards it. Invalid input: common price formats are read ("Rp1.250.000.000", "1,25 M", "850 jt"); a row with an unreadable price or area, or a missing required column, is rejected with its row number and reason while the other rows import; a file without the required header is refused with the list of expected columns. Repeat: the Impor button locks after one click, so one click = one import. Expiry: each listing shows its import date by the laptop clock (WIB); listings imported more than 30 days ago are marked "cek apakah masih dijual".
decisions.rationale: Routine recoveries taken as safe defaults (S4 guidance; deliver-edge-cases checklist via grilling). Shown for correction.

decisions.summary: F-01 Import listings and build the shortlist — priority: must.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q5).

decisions.summary: Duplicates: listings with the same link are one house; the newest import replaces the older data and the preview reports "X listing diperbarui". The same house advertised on two sites stays as two listings (different links).
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q6).

decisions.summary: F-02 Set profile and criteria — happy path: open Profile & Criteria; Finance: net monthly income, total other installments, cash available; KPR: per bank minimum DP (default 5%), promo rate and promo length, floating rate (default 11%), tenor (default 20 years), installment cap 30%; Must-have criteria: max price, area (Jaksel/Depok), min bedrooms, min land area, new/resale/both — failing any drops the house; Nice-to-have: larger building area, more bedrooms, SHM, new house — used for ordering; click Simpan; the shortlist recalculates and the page shows "Tersimpan" with the date. A house is also dropped when its upfront cash (DP + BPHTB + bank fees + notary/insurance) exceeds the cash available.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q7).

decisions.summary: F-02 unhappy-path defaults. Abandon: leaving with unsaved changes shows "Ada perubahan belum disimpan"; nothing is saved without Simpan. Invalid input: each field checks its range (amounts ≥ 0; DP 0–100%; rates 0–30%; tenor 1–30 years; cap 1–100%) with a message next to the field, and Simpan stays disabled until fixed. Empty profile: the Shortlist page shows "Isi profil keuangan dulu" with a link and applies only the must-have criteria. Two tabs: saving from an outdated tab is refused with "Data sudah diubah di tab lain — muat ulang". Expiry: each rate and default shows its last-updated date with the 30-day warning (D-020).
decisions.rationale: Routine recoveries taken as safe defaults; shown for correction.

decisions.summary: F-02 Set profile and criteria — priority: must.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q8).

decisions.summary: F-03 Update default figures — happy path: a yellow banner on any page ("N angka bawaan lebih dari 30 hari — perbarui") opens the Default Figures part of Profile & Criteria: NPOPTKP per area (Jaksel Rp250 juta, Depok Rp80 juta), bank fees per bank (provisi, administration, appraisal), notary and insurance estimates, each with last-updated date and source link; the owner checks the source, edits or clicks "Tandai sudah dicek", clicks Simpan; dates become today, the banner disappears and the shortlist recalculates. Priority: should.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q9). Supports D-020.

decisions.summary: Split by priority. F-04 Export backup and delete data (must): open Data & privasi from the footer link; Ekspor cadangan shows the D-031 warning, Lanjut downloads kpr-cadangan-YYYY-MM-DD.json; delete offers all data, one import file, or the financial profile only, confirmed by typing HAPUS, ending with "Data dihapus". F-05 Restore from backup (should): Pulihkan dari cadangan, choose the file, see its contents (listing count, profile date) and a replace warning, type PULIHKAN; the app first exports an automatic backup of the current data, then restores.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S4.q10). One feature per priority so scope lock can treat them separately.

decisions.summary: F-03 unhappy-path defaults. Abandon: unsaved edits are lost with the same "Ada perubahan belum disimpan" warning as F-02. Invalid input: amounts ≥ 0, percentages 0–100, with field messages. Repeat: Tandai sudah dicek twice only refreshes the date. Expiry: the 30-day clock per figure uses the laptop date (WIB); a laptop date earlier than a saved date shows no warning and no error.
decisions.rationale: Routine recoveries taken as safe defaults (enough protocol, step 2); shown for correction.

decisions.summary: F-04 and F-05 unhappy-path defaults. Export: if the download is cancelled nothing changes and the backup reminder stays. Delete: typing anything but HAPUS keeps the button disabled; a cancelled delete changes nothing. Restore: a file that is not a valid app backup, or is from a newer app version, is refused before anything changes; the automatic backup is written first, and if the restore fails midway the app returns to the state before restoring and says so. Repeat: delete and restore buttons lock after one click.
decisions.rationale: Routine recoveries taken as safe defaults; shown for correction.

decisions.summary: First run and stopped app. First open: the Import CSV page shows a short three-step guide (1. isi profil, 2. impor CSV, 3. lihat daftar pendek) and a downloadable sample CSV with the expected columns. If the terminal is closed while a page is open, the next click shows the browser's own connection error; nothing half-saved remains because each save is all-or-nothing. Screen target: laptop browser first; phone layout is not planned (D-002).
decisions.rationale: S4 bank question 9 and web profile S4 (web-empty, web-retry, web-device), taken as safe defaults; shown for correction.

decisions.summary: Recommended stack: Python 3.15 with the built-in sqlite3 store, one local data file in the owner's home folder, served on 127.0.0.1 only and started with one command. Node.js 26 LTS with node:sqlite was weighed and not chosen.
decisions.rationale: sqlite3 is part of the Python standard library, while node:sqlite is still "Stability: 1.2 - Release candidate" [cite: version · https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html · n.d. · acc 2026-11-27 · primary · live]; Python 3.15 is supported to 2031-10 [cite: version · https://devguide.python.org/versions/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-27 · primary · live]. Both cost Rp0 (S2.q3); a stable store fits the 15-minute monthly upkeep (D-020).

decisions.summary: Rumah123 is the reference tool: result labels follow its wording where it fits D-001 (for example "Angsuran/bulan", "Uang Muka", "Sisa Pinjaman Setelah Periode Fix").
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S5.q2). Familiar labels reduce reading effort; per the competitor scan [cite: general · https://www.rumah123.com/kpr/simulasi-kpr/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-27 · primary · live].

decisions.summary: Runtime: the Python 3.14 already on the laptop (3.14.4), supported to 2030-10; no extra Python install is needed. The handover only checks python3 --version shows 3.12 or newer and gives an upgrade note for later.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S5.q3). Python 3.14 is in bugfix status with end of life 2030-10 [cite: version · https://devguide.python.org/versions/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-27 · primary · live]; Django 6.1 needs Python >=3.12 (signals snapshot). Installing 3.15 would add upkeep without a benefit.

decisions.summary: Web framework: Django 6.1.3 on the laptop's Python 3.14, with SQLite as the single local data file; ALLOWED_HOSTS limited to localhost and 127.0.0.1 (D-021) and the built-in CSRF/Origin check on every data-changing request (D-028). FastAPI 0.165.0 was weighed (score 66 vs 86) and not chosen.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S5.q4), following the recommendation. Django's Host check and Origin-checking CSRF are built in [cite: version · https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/stable/ref/csrf/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-27 · primary · live]; FastAPI would need python-multipart and custom security middleware.

decisions.summary: Storage: one SQLite database file in the owner's home folder, managed by Django migrations. Rejected: JSON files (no atomic multi-record update) and Postgres/Supabase (needs a server or online account). A unique index on the listing link enforces D-039.
decisions.rationale: Data-module comparison in the S6 risks: one user, one device, offline (D-005, D-002, D-022), about 1,200–7,200 listings a year (D-018), atomic saves needed for D-047 and F-05. Shown to the owner for confirmation (S6.q2).

decisions.summary: Regulated-domain screen: finance, health, legal services and minors are all absent. The tool estimates for the owner's own purchase only and is not shared or sold; sharing or selling it reopens this screen and D-023.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S6.q1). Evidence: D-005, D-014, D-023, D-033.

decisions.summary: Retention: listings, shortlist and profile are kept until the owner deletes them (F-04); nothing is deleted automatically.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S6.q3). Volume is small (D-018); old listings help compare prices; stale ones are marked after 30 days (D-037).

decisions.summary: Tenor is capped by age: the owner types their current age in Profile & Criteria (stored only in the local database); each bank has a maximum tenor (default 25 years) and a maximum age at loan end (default 65; 66 for self-employed); the tenor used = the smallest of the entered tenor, the maximum tenor and (age limit - current age). The shortlist shows the tenor actually used.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q3). Fixes scope review RV-L02-b541707a: BCA allows at most 25 years and age 65/66 at loan end (RQ-015); a fixed 20-year tenor understates the installment for older buyers and breaks D-004.

decisions.summary: Notary/PPAT and insurance estimates have no default: until the owner enters them (F-03), each house's upfront cash shows 'belum lengkap', and no house is marked as passing the upfront-cash rule; such houses are listed in a separate 'Dana tunai belum lengkap' group with the missing items named.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q4). Fixes RV-L01-f3dc2e5c: no sourced figure exists in the plan, and a Rp0 default would let unaffordable houses pass the D-040 drop rule.

decisions.summary: CSV import accepts ',' or ';' as the separator (auto-detected from the header row), UTF-8 with or without BOM, and prices as plain digits, 'Rp1.500.000.000' (dots as thousand separators) or '1,5 M' / '850 jt'; any other value makes the row rejected with its reason.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q5). Fixes RV-L02-47261332: spreadsheets set to Indonesian save CSV with ';' and dotted prices.

decisions.summary: Install and start in a virtual environment: python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install 'Django==6.1.3'; start with one command that runs .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. Fallback when PyPI is unreachable: a saved Django wheel in the project folder.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q5). Fixes RV-L10-31d97b4b: PEP 668 makes distro Python refuse global pip installs (RQ-015).

decisions.summary: BCA administration fee defaults follow the loan size: Rp500.000 up to Rp500 juta, 0,10% of the loan above Rp500 juta up to Rp3 miliar, Rp3.000.000 above Rp3 miliar; editable in F-03.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q5). Fixes RV-L01-be07777c; BCA KPR page re-fetched 2026-11-27 (RQ-015). The LTV end date 31 Dec 2027 is kept and now cites the BI press release of 21 Oct 2026 (RQ-016, fixes RV-L01-c4a7d48b).

decisions.summary: Measurable success (refines D-004): one file of about 200 listings becomes a saved shortlist in under 10 minutes, and a hand check of 5 shortlisted houses against the 30% rule at the floating rate finds 0 over the cap.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q6). Fixes RV-L15-2e67bd28.

decisions.summary: Kill criteria per in-MVP feature: F-01 reworked if a 200-row file cannot be shortlisted in under 10 minutes; F-02 reworked if the owner still recomputes affordability by hand; F-03 dropped if no default figure is edited in 3 months; F-04 kept regardless (privacy erasure, D-026); F-05 dropped if no restore is needed in 6 months.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q6). Fixes RV-L04-e7e37a89.

decisions.summary: Scope locked: in-MVP F-01, F-02, F-03, F-04, F-05; Parking Lot empty. Scope review run 1 findings fixed through D-055–D-061 before the lock; no risk accepted.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S7.q7), an explicit yes to the lock question.

decisions.summary: Milestone order: M0 walking skeleton (start, import, list) -> M1 calculations and profile (F-02) -> M2 full import and ranked shortlist (F-01) -> M3 default figures and reminders (F-03) -> M4 backup, delete, restore and final re-check (F-04, F-05).
decisions.rationale: Calculations come before the ranked shortlist because F-01 ranks by upfront cash and installment; each milestone fits one builder session. Shown for correction at the S8 review.

decisions.summary: Quality targets: current Firefox and Chromium on the owner Linux laptop; labels, keyboard path and visible focus; local log file without finance fields, kept 30 days; dates stored in UTC and shown in WIB.
decisions.rationale: One user on one Linux laptop (S2.q3, D-047); no data leaves the laptop (D-022). Shown for correction at the S8 review.

decisions.summary: Review run 2 fixes applied: Global smoke test as 9 numbered steps with expected outputs (RV-L12-122067bb); M0 start.sh runs migrate before runserver (RV-L05-b8ff3174); expired DNS-rebinding cite replaced by Django ALLOWED_HOSTS docs (RV-L01-145bd803).
decisions.rationale: Source: rekomendasi diterima atas delegasi pemilik (the owner delegated every remaining decision on 2026-11-27). The three fixes are the review recommendations, each mechanical or research, with no change to scope, cost or behavior.

milestones.goal: One command starts the app on the laptop (127.0.0.1 only) and an imported CSV shows on the Shortlist page from the real SQLite file
Profile, criteria and money calculations: installments during and after promo, age-capped tenor, upfront cash, belum lengkap
Full CSV import and the ranked shortlist saved as CSV
Default figures with dates and sources, 30-day and backup reminders
Backup, delete by typing HAPUS, safe restore, privacy page, and the M0 checks re-run
